title: Legacy input whose amount comes without its previous transaction

wallet.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

attack: The coin holds 0.05 BTC but the PSBT says 0.01 BTC and leaves out the previous transaction. A legacy signature does not commit to the amount, so the 0.04 BTC difference goes to the miner while the screen shows a 10,000 sat fee.
rule: Refuse a legacy input that does not carry its previous transaction.
